tips: 💡 Tip: Send images as a File to preserve their original quality and avoid Telegram's image compression.
💡 Tip: Send multiple images and use /merge_vertically or /merge_horizontally to combine them vertically or horizontally, or use the grid tool.
💡 Tip: Use /settings to adjust the output format (JPEG, PNG, WEBP), quality, and number of grid columns.
💡 Tip: Reorder your images with the 🔼🔽 buttons before merging — order matters!
💡 Tip: Use the compression tool from the Tools menu to reduce image size while maintaining good visual quality.
💡 Tip: Convert images between formats (JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, HEIC) with the Convert Format button.
💡 Tip: Use the 🙈 Censor tool to automatically blur or pixelate human faces in photos before sharing them.
💡 Tip: The bot supports HEIC and HEIF images, including photos from iPhone.
💡 Tip: Extract text from images using OCR — with support for English, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, Russian, and Arabic.
💡 Tip: Remove sensitive metadata such as GPS location, camera information, and author details before sharing images.
💡 Tip: Convert a set of images into a single PDF with the Create PDF button.
💡 Tip: Send a PDF to extract its pages as images in a ZIP file or extract its full text.
💡 Tip: Convert a PDF to an editable DOCX file — useful for reusing its content.
💡 Tip: Send a DOCX file to extract its text, convert its pages to images, or convert it to PDF.
💡 Tip: Send multiple PDF files and use Merge PDFs to combine them into a single file.
💡 Tip: You can download Telegram stickers as PNG or WEBP images using the bot.
💡 Tip: In /settings, you can choose how many columns the image grid uses.
💡 Tip: Use the Tools menu to access OCR, metadata removal, and other features.
💡 Tip: Track your usage statistics from Tools → My Usage.
💡 Tip: Did you know you can support the bot for free just by watching an ad? Go to Menu > My Usage > Support the Bot and tap Watch Ad!

help_file_caption: 📄 User Manual - MergeImages We've prepared a detailed guide covering all of the bot's features. Open the file above to learn how to get the most out of MergeImages.
help_html_content:
🚀 Welcome to MergeImages!

I am your assistant for editing, organizing, converting, and protecting images and documents directly within Telegram. Everything works via the main menu, the tools menu, or the action buttons below sent files.

🖼️ Images

Merge Images: join multiple images vertically or horizontally.
Grid: create a custom photo grid by choosing the number of columns.
Convert: convert images between JPG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, and PDF.
Compress: reduce file size while maintaining high visual quality.
Remove Background: automatically remove image backgrounds using AI.
🙈 Censor / Blur Faces: automatically detect and blur human faces (light to extreme blur or mosaic pixelation).
Watermark: add custom text or visual watermarks to your images.
Visual Search: search images on Google Lens to discover sources and similar items.
Metadata: view or remove sensitive EXIF data, such as GPS and camera info.

📄 PDF and DOCX

Create PDF: convert images into a PDF with customizable orientation and layout.
Merge PDFs: send multiple PDF documents and combine them into a single file.
Extract Pages: extract pages from PDF or DOCX documents as individual images.
Extract Text: extract text from PDFs, DOCX, and images using multilingual OCR.
Convert PDF ↔ DOCX: convert documents between PDF and Word formats.
Remove Metadata: strip hidden metadata and author properties from PDF files.

🎞️ Creative Tools

GIF: convert videos to GIF, GIFs to video, extract frames, and adjust FPS/scale.
Stickers: convert images into stickers and stickers back into images.
QR Code: generate QR codes from text/links and scan QR codes directly from photos.
Meme: create memes with top and bottom captions.
ZIP: bundle your queue into a convenient ZIP archive.
Other Bots: discover useful sister bots from the same developer.

⚙️ Settings & Usage

Settings: customize language, output format, quality, background, borders, and resize behavior.
My Usage: view your personal usage stats, ranking, and account activity.
Support Tickets: submit a ticket whenever you need assistance or want to suggest an idea.
Cancel: clear your current image and document queue at any time.

❤️ Support & Contributions

Telegram Stars: support the bot directly via Telegram Stars packs.
Watch Ads: watch voluntary short ads to keep the server online for free.
USDT via TON: contribute over the TON network via @wallet; each 1 USDT equals 100 Stars on the Leaderboard.
Cryptocurrencies: send crypto donations to the wallets displayed in the support menu.
Supporter Leaderboard: check the global rankings combining Stars, USDT/crypto, and ad support.
Monthly Goal: when an active goal is running, track community progress towards server hosting costs.

✅ How to Use

1. Send one or more supported images, PDFs, DOCX files, videos, or stickers.

2. Use the interactive buttons beneath the file or open Menu > Tools.

3. Adjust your preferences in Settings before processing if desired.

Tip: Send images as File to prevent Telegram compression and preserve 100% original quality.
